create_root_module: create a RootModule instance from a Motion with hip, shoulder, and neck bone names for biped or quadruped topology
compute_root_transforms: compute root transform matrices for a motion clip by analyzing hip and shoulder bone positions to derive forward direction and root rotation
get_root_transforms_with_smoothing: get smoothed root transforms at given timestamps using Gaussian-weighted position and direction blending over a time window
get_root_velocities: get root velocity vectors at timestamps by computing the difference between current and previous root positions divided by delta time
control_root_series: control a RootModule Series by setting position, direction, and velocity at a pivot index then interpolating across remaining samples
